We make uptime monitoring, on-call and status pages for teams who want fewer, better alerts. Founded 2021 People on the team 38 Countries we work from 11 Teams on Navy 4,000 /// Story Why Navy exists Navy started in 2021, after one of our founders spent a weekend answering pages for an outage that turned out to be a single flaky network route. Every tool we tried either missed real outages or cried wolf, and on-call engineers had learned to ignore both. So we built the monitor we wanted: checks from many regions, an outage only when three of them agree, and alerts that go to one person instead of a whole channel. The status page came next, because customers deserve to hear about problems from you first. Today Navy runs more than two billion checks a month for 4,000 teams, from two-person startups to companies with rotati
